walkthrough.student.title: Get started with Computor
walkthrough.student.description: From your course to a submitted solution, with the actions on the assignment row.
walkthrough.student.row.altText: An assignment row with its title and action icons.
walkthrough.student.connect.title: Connect and sign in
walkthrough.student.connect.description:
Point Computor at your server and sign in with the same account as on the Computor website. For computor.at, the backend URL is https://computor.at/api. No account yet? Create one on the website and join your course there.
[Set the backend URL](command:computor.changeRealmUrl)
[Sign in](command:computor.login)
walkthrough.student.openCourse.title: Open your course
walkthrough.student.openCourse.descripti:
Find your courses under the book in the Activity Bar. Click an assignment title to open its instructions and Python source: instructions on the left and code on the right on a desktop, or tabs on a narrow screen. First use may prepare your personal course repository. The arrow expands other files.
[Open the Student view](command:computor.student.courses.focus)
walkthrough.student.testAndSubmit.title: Test and submit
walkthrough.student.testAndSubmit.descri: Point to an assignment or focus its row to show its action icons. Choose “Test Assignment”, then “Submit”. The same actions are available in the context menu. The assignment is done when its square carries the green double check.
walkthrough.student.welcomePage.title: Welcome page and help
walkthrough.student.welcomePage.descript:
The welcome page explains every icon and every mark on a row and links the help pages.
[Open the welcome page](command:computor.welcome)
